Governing calibration target for each peak

dot-assign_target_rows.Rd

Governing calibration target for each peak

Usage

.assign_target_rows(peaks, matched, targets)

Arguments

peaks

Tibble with an O (oxygen count) column.

matched

Character vector from .match_targets().

targets

Tibble with columns target and type ("hydrocarbon" or "oxygenate").

Value

Integer vector of row indices into peaks: the nearest preceding matched target of the same type (oxygenates use oxygenate targets), else the first matched target; NA when no target matched.
